name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Log Size Ratio (affine)
details: Every finite nontrivial binary class satisfies $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\,\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(n+1)$, where $n$ is the ambient domain size.
proof: Every positive no-clashing teacher is in particular a no-clashing teacher. Thus $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)$, and the no-clashing counting argument gives the stated log-size-ratio lower bound directly.
proof_source: Corollary cor:positive-nctd-low-log-size-ratio in the LaTeX survey.
